en.en: The **Agricultural System** in the **Indian Economy** forms the backbone of primary sector activities, supporting nearly half of the nation's workforce. Within the **UPSC GS-3** syllabus, analyzing this system requires examining how agro-climatic zones, landholding patterns, and technological adoption interact. It integrates diverse components such as seed systems, irrigation networks, credit availability, and marketing channels.
